sources.context: Wild-type Bacillus subtilis parental strain 168 during exponential growth; microscopy and morphogenesis analysis explicitly support the coarse rod-shaped presentation class.

Exact selected Bacillus subtilis 168 trp+ sigE- physiology background in aerobic M9 glucose growth at 37 C; supports the derivative identity and the bounded transfer away from sporulation-state morphology.

provenance.context: Coarse representative morphology for Petra's selected Bacillus subtilis 168 trp+ sigE- shared-resource competitor pack.
provenance.transferNote: Rod morphology is transferred from direct microscopy/morphogenesis evidence for the parental 168 background to the exact selected trp+ sigE- derivative only as a coarse exponential-growth representative silhouette. The selected physiology source reports the sigE mutation as phenotypically silent under its unrestricted glucose-growth condition while blocking later sporulation; no exact-derivative cell-shape measurement is claimed.
provenance.limitation: Authorizes only a rod-shaped representative glyph for the named Bacillus pack. It does not authorize physical cell length, width, aspect ratio, chain length, orientation or division dynamics, one-glyph-per-cell identity, literal cell counts, sporulation morphology, motility, colony shape, or any simulation parameter.
